description: Header file defining the TrafficSeparationTask class responsible for managing traffic separation rules in the prplMesh agent. It includes class declarations, method signatures, enums, and private members related to traffic separation logic.

classes.name: TrafficSeparationTask
classes.description: Final class responsible for applying EasyMesh Traffic Separation rules on the agent platform, inheriting from Task.

methods.name: TrafficSeparationTask
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task, reads configuration, and creates the TS manager.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Periodic task hook executed by the scheduler to run pending recomputation actions.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles task events such as enabling traffic separation, adding or clearing backhaul STA interfaces, or clearing configuration.

methods.name: clear_configuration
methods.description: Clears all traffic separation rules and resets internal state.

methods.name: stronger_mode
methods.description: Returns the stronger apply mode between two modes, with full mode taking precedence.

methods.name: schedule_apply
methods.description: Queues a traffic separation apply action with debounce.

methods.name: clear_pending_apply
methods.description: Resets the pending debounce state.

methods.name: should_run_now
methods.description: Checks if the debounce timeout has expired and apply can run.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Performs full traffic separation recomputation and application.

methods.name: handle_new_sta_iface
methods.description: Incrementally adds new backhaul STA interfaces.

methods.name: handle_clear_sta_iface
methods.description: Incrementally clears stale backhaul STA interfaces.

methods.name: collect_current_wds_ifaces
methods.description: Discovers current backhaul WDS interfaces and their TS mode.

methods.name: cleanup_ts_runtime_state
methods.description: Clears TS state and restores transport defaults outside TS mode.

methods.name: ensure_transport_primary_vlan
methods.description: Configures the primary VLAN in transport/broker when it changes.

methods.name: reset_transport_monitoring_on_bridge
methods.description: Resets broker interface monitoring to default after TS cleanup.

methods.name: build_ts_config
methods.description: Builds the manager configuration from database or BPL.

methods.name: collect_ports_from_db
methods.description: Collects trunk and access ports from current database state.

methods.name: add_backhaul_connection_trunk
methods.description: Adds the current backhaul connection interface as a trunk candidate.

methods.name: get_all_sta_ifaces_for_bss
methods.description: Returns all STA interfaces matching a given BSS interface.

methods.name: sta_index_for_prefix
methods.description: Parses decimal suffix of interfaces with expected prefix, returns -1 if invalid.
